title: Experimental Jetset website
lede: The Amsterdam studio’s online archive: a directory listing of every project, set in one size of Helvetica on a six-column grid.
summary: Six columns of project titles and dates in one size of black Helvetica on white, with finished projects struck through.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 25 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: A clear example of the grid and the type: every line sits in one of six columns, in black Helvetica, flush left. It has no scale contrast at all, so it fails the `type.sizeRange` metric (see the style page).

observed: A plain text header reads “Experimental Jetset” at the top left and “Search” at the top right.
A short vertical menu lists Archive (in bold), Preview, News, About, and Contact.
A thin black rule spans the page under the menu and a Categories drop-down.
Below the rule, six equal columns list project titles, each with a month and year aligned to the right of the column.
Many titles are struck through. All text is black on white and appears to be the same size.
interpretation: The measurement finds only Helvetica, only black and white, square corners, and no centered text. Every text run is 13.2 px, so the size range is 1.
The grid carries the whole page: the directory reads as a table because the columns are strict, not because of rules or boxes.
borrow: Let a long list become the layout: equal columns, one type size, and dates aligned to a fixed column edge.

images.alt: Experimental Jetset archive page: a small menu at the top left, a thin rule, and six dense columns of project titles with dates, all in small black Helvetica on white, many titles struck through.
images.caption: First viewport of [jetset.nl](https://www.jetset.nl/).
